t: How does a Turbine generate energy?$(br2)By spinning its $(l:bigreactors/rotor)Rotor$(/l).$(br2)The fluid from the Turbine Vapor Fluid Tank is pumped into the $(l:bigreactors/rotor)Rotor$(/l) chamber at the rate you configured in the $(l:bigreactors/part-controller)Controller$(/l) graphical interface.$(br2)A small amount of the vapor is captured by each $(l:bigreactors/part-rotorblade)Rotor Blade$(/l), causing the $(l:bigreactors/rotor)Rotor$(/l) to spin.

涡轮机是如何产生能量的？$(br2)靠它旋转的$(l:bigreactors/rotor)转子$(/l)。$(br2)涡轮机蒸汽流体储罐中的流体会按照你在$(l:bigreactors/part-controller)控制器$(/l)图形界面中设置的速率，被泵入$(l:bigreactors/rotor)转子$(/l)腔室。$(br2)每个$(l:bigreactors/part-rotorblade)扇叶$(/l)都会捕获少量蒸汽，从而带动$(l:bigreactors/rotor)转子$(/l)旋转。

When the $(l:bigreactors/coils)Induction Coils$(/l) are $(l:bigreactors/part-controller)engaged$(/l), energy is generated depending on the $(l:bigreactors/rotor)Rotor$(/l) speed and the average values of properties like efficiency and drag amount of all your coil blocks.$(br2)$(italic)Please note that, while this overview allows you to create the best Turbines possible, it is an oversimplification of what's really going on inside your Turbine.$()

当$(l:bigreactors/coils)感应线圈$(/l)处于$(l:bigreactors/part-controller)接合$(/l)状态时，系统会根据$(l:bigreactors/rotor)转子$(/l)的转速，以及你所有线圈方块在效率、阻力等属性上的平均值来生成能量。$(br2)$(italic)请注意，虽然这段概述足以帮助你造出尽可能优秀的涡轮机，但它仍然是对涡轮机内部实际机制的简化说明。$()
